text:
alex: Quick pre-cut check — aiming to freeze changelog + sample apps for the SDK/docs release. Need clear owners for: sample app fixes, changelog slice, docs build/linkcheck, and canary smoke. Target: cut tag by Thu EOD. Who can take what?
marie: I can take sample apps (python + node examples). Will triage CI failures today, ETA Wed noon.
sam: I'll own the changelog slice + release notes. Please @ me on merged PRs you want called out — need final text by Wed 6pm.
joel: I can run the canary smoke runs and validate runtime on dedicated. Need a staging tag pushed and the canary playbook updated.
indra: Docs build + linkcheck I can run Wed morning. Any additional CLI flags or breaking notes to include?
marie: We added a new `--batch-size` flag in SDK v1.4 and a small config change for samplekit.
sam: Got it — will add `--batch-size` to changelog under "Notable CLI flags". Also will include samplekit config snippet.
alex: Nice. Quick blocker check: are there any sample apps requiring secrets that will block canary?
joel: One private sample needs API key rotation. @security-bot — do we have a short-lived key for canary?
security-bot: FYI: Short-lived service key can be issued, but needs audit ticket. @alex please confirm and I'll generate.
alex: Confirmed, create audit ticket and mark for canary usage only.
marie: CI note: samplekit-tests failing on Windows runner — 3 flakes in `auth_flow`. I'll open a skip PR and follow-up fix PR.
sam: If you skip, can we add a note in the changelog that Windows quickstart had a temporary skip? Avoid surprises.
indra: Also, any API surface changes to document besides `--batch-size`?
marie: Minor telemetry field renamed (`client_id` -> `client_key`) — will add to docs PR.
joel: For the canary runs, I need the staging tag name and the build artifact path. Whoever cuts the tag, ping me with the `artifact_url` like: `gs://ci-artifacts/sdk/v1.4/staging.tar.gz`.
alex: I'll cut the staging tag once sample app skips are in. Plan: tag by Thu 10:00 UTC, cut final by Thu 18:00 UTC.
marie: I'll target the skip PR this afternoon.
sam: Please add me to the changelog PR as reviewer. I'll consolidate and push final release notes.
indra: I'll queue docs build Wed 09:00 UTC and run linkcheck. If any broken links, I'll open fixes and ping authors.
joel: After tag, I'll run two canary passes (smoke + regression). Expect results in the thread.
alex: Thanks all. Action items recap — alex: cut tags; marie: sample app skips + fix PR; sam: changelog + review; indra: docs build/linkcheck; joel: canary runs; security-bot: issue short-lived key after audit ticket. Post any updates here and call out blockers asap. :thumbsup:
marie: One more — can someone own updating sampleapp readmes to reflect `--batch-size` and the telemetry rename? I can do the code changes but could use a quick readme pass from docs folks.
indra: I'll take readme copy edits as a follow-up after your PR lands.
sam: And I'll include a short "migration notes" blurb in the changelog for `client_key` rename.
alex: Great. Closing loop — if no major blockers by Wed EOD, proceed to tag on Thu. Otherwise raise here and we'll triage.
devex-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Changelog freeze check" in #devex tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
marie: Thanks — will post PR links once available.
